confirmed_missing_contracts: Complete-transaction policy-context guarantee remains deferred for user design review
notes: The qualified release images include the tested local changes based on the recorded commits; the source manifest identifies the exact source files.
The demo uses one ComputationGraph with direct in-memory query indexes and real PostgreSQL, native transformers, Server APIs and SSE.
PostgreSQL retains published committed row-by-row delivery. Strict acceptance still fails only its final complete-transaction capability assertion; that assertion is not bypassed.
React is consumed as a built tarball, never a source alias.
